verdict.rationale: Jules is exactly this kind of built-in agentic assistant: users delegate coding tasks via GitHub issue labels, the web app, or API, and Jules autonomously plans, clones repos, runs in a VM, and returns diffs/PRs for approval (jules-docs-2,3,4,7,8,9). Community evidence corroborates real-world task delegation and usable output (jules-comm-2, jules-comm-11, jules-comm-15, jules-comm-16), though mixed reports of loops, babysitting needs, and reliability issues (jules-comm-14, jules-comm-18) temper quality. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of task success rates and evidence of consistent reliability at scale.
